facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mole lived under the ground. It was dark down there. One spring day, he wanted to go outside. Mole went up.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Mole had always lived deep underground in his little home. One beautiful spring day, warm air came down into his tunnel. He felt excited and started digging upward. He dug and dug until he saw bright sunlight. Mole went up into the fresh air for the first time. The whole world was green and beautiful above him.
facts.Word cards: Mole = 두더지 / outside = 밖으로 / spring = 봄 / underground = 땅 속에
